articles.title: What to know about the Green Line shutdowns planned for August
articles.description:
The MBTA announced service changes in August to support tunnel upgrades and ongoing accessibility improvements to the Green Line.

The post What to know about the Green Line shutdowns planned for August appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: MBTA plans Green Line shutdowns in August for tunnel upgrades and accessibility improvements.
Shutdowns will affect multiple stations, impacting thousands of daily commuters.
Residents should prepare for service changes and potential delays during the upgrades.

articles.title: Suffolk corrections officer killed after stopping to help stranded motorist in Boxford
articles.description:
The 51-year-old was struck Monday evening while assisting another driver and later died at a hospital, authorities said.

The post Suffolk corrections officer killed after stopping to help stranded motorist in Boxford appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Suffolk corrections officer, 51, was killed while assisting a stranded motorist in Boxford.
The officer was struck on Monday evening and later died at a hospital.
This incident raises concerns about safety for drivers and first responders in Boston.
